long_biography.plain_text:
Greece's financial crisis prompted Byron Nicolaides to take PeopleCert's computer-skills certification business into international markets. Acquiring AXELOS subsequently brought the ITIL and PRINCE2 frameworks into the group, giving it control of the intellectual property behind major professional qualifications.

Nicolaides grew up in Istanbul with two teachers as parents, and regards educational support as repayment for the opportunities his schooling provided. He has helped equip his old school, Zografeion, while PeopleCert provides scholarships for young people with roots in the city's Greek community. The company also covers the cost of English lessons for schoolchildren in Istanbul and Imvros.
